## Summary

What does this PR change, and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] 3D model / CAD / enclosure
- [ ] Firmware
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Other

## Validation

- [ ] I reviewed the existing project documentation.
- [ ] I tested the change, or clearly stated that it is untested.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation.
- [ ] I removed secrets and unrelated files.

## For 3D model changes

- [ ] Editable CAD source included, if available.
- [ ] STL files included.
- [ ] Units and print settings documented.
- [ ] Required screws, inserts, or extra parts documented.
- [ ] Fit-tested status is stated accurately.
- [ ] Photos or renders included, if available.

## Additional notes

Anything reviewers should know?
